cause: The hostile harness used RoutingPolicy() with its default deny-all permission policy. The synthetic record was therefore rejected before its intentionally forged archive hash reached the archive-bound profile check.
disposition: No product gate was weakened and no release was certified. The complete hostile result, framework freeze, and clean-room environment are preserved beside this diagnostic. The harness must allow only the declared local-inference permission so the intended profile-hash guard is exercised.
